clip.title: Other buttons
clip.description: Buttons 2–9 have the same Caption, Level and When pressed controls as button 1. This silent configuration clip changes button 2's caption to Applause, lowers its level to -12 dB and chooses Loop (press again to stop), then returns to the top. The separate Level recording lets you hear the level change through the production engine. Drop a WAV or MP3 onto a button to replace its sound, or onto the card or Properties to fill the next free button.

clip.title: Other bands
clip.description: Bands 2–16 work the same way as band 1, so only band 1 is recorded field by field. About three seconds in, a second band is added by double-clicking the graph where it should sit (the Add point button adds one at 1,000 Hz instead), then set to a 9 dB cut at 5,000 Hz. Band 1 keeps its 9 dB boost at 1,000 Hz, so you hear both bands at once while steady pink noise plays through the Advanced EQ. The panel calls each band a point: pick any of them from Select point to change its filter, frequency, gain and Q.
